title: Correlation Wayfinder — session navigation & microflow inspector
creator: Maya Chen
description: Summary: Design and prototype 'Correlation Wayfinder', a compact session-level navigator for the Redwood Console to let engineers rapidly pivot across correlated requests, zoom into microflows, and compare span-level metrics. Focus areas: 1) compact correlation ribbon that surfaces top correlated trace ids and 'jump-to' actions, 2) microflow slicer to isolate span groups by service, latency, or error, 3) sticky timeline with contextual hover previews and keyboard navigation, 4) integrated cost/compute annotation per request segment. Deliverables: high-fidelity Figma prototype, interaction spec for eng, accessibility pass, 5-run usability study, and PRD updates.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable correlation ribbon that expands to related session list
Timeline hover previews show up to 3 downstream spans with latency/cost badges
Keyboard nav: left/right to move spans; enter to open detailed span pane
Microflow slicer preserves filters across rollouts & supports A/B comparisons
Design spec with edge-case states (large session, missing spans, partial KV cache) published in Confluence
